Commentary on Surah 104: Al-Humazah (Woe to every backbiter and slanderer)

It is Meccan.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

* *

Al-Hammaz (the backbiter) is one who does so by speech, and al-Lammaz (the slanderer) is one who does so by action. That is, one who belittles people and disparages them. The explanation of this has already been given in His words: ﴿a constant mocker, going about with slander﴾ [al-Qalam: 11].

Ibn 'Abbas said: ﴿backbiter, slanderer﴾ means one who reviles and finds fault. Al-Rabi' ibn Anas said: al-Humazah is one who insults him to his face, and al-Lumazah is one who does so behind his back. Qatadah said: he insults him and defames him with his tongue and his eye, eats the flesh of people, and attacks them.

Mujahid said: al-Humazah is with the hand and the eye, and al-Lumazah is with the tongue. Ibn Zayd said likewise. Malik related from Zayd ibn Aslam: humazah is eating the flesh of people.
